summary: Sweden, software developer, strong interest in open-source software, avid cyclist, expertise in programming languages (especially C#, Java, and functional programming), critical of DRM and content protection methods, advocates for state-subsidized childcare and parental leave, believes in the importance of community and rational decision-making in governance, engaged in discussions about labor laws and employee rights, supports the idea of a queryable filesystem interface, has a background in computer science education, enjoys photography and image editing software, follows European football and live sports streaming, critical of Java's design flaws and performance issues.
